title: Toronto Sailing & Canoe Club

services.name: Learn to sail
services.desc: Toronto Sailing & Canoe Club offers the city’s best adult learn-to-sail programs, on both dinghies and keelboats. Every instructor is trained and certified by national authorities in boat safety and first aid, and is ready to provide a safe, fun-filled experience. The TS&CC sailing school curriculum is based on Sail Canada standards. Students can earn nationally recognized certificates by demonstrating skills learned in the program. No previous sailing experience is required to enroll in CANSail 1 (dinghies) or Basic Cruising (keelboats). After CANSail 1 and Basic Cruising, students must have completed the previous level in order to advance to the next one. For more information, visit our

services.name: Summer camps
services.desc: Our club offers some of Toronto’s best learn-to-sail programs for youth ages 6 to 17. Camps generally run Monday to Friday from 9:00 am to 4:00 pm from early July to late August. Two-week and four-week segments are available. Our sailing instructors are experienced and accomplished sailors, trained and certified by Sail Canada. Every instructor is certified by national authorities in boat safety and First Aid, and they provide a safe and fun-filled learning experience for all students. All youth courses are two weeks long unless otherwise indicated. Students may sometimes arrange to attend in one-week segments, but completion of the curriculum and achievement of CANSail certifications

services.name: Private lessons
services.desc: In addition to group learn-to-sail lessons, we offer private sailing instruction for adults and youth on dinghies (420 or RS Visions) and keelboats. Private lessons are conducted by experienced instructors, and can be scheduled seven days a week, June to September. We can accommodate any skill level, from brand-new sailors to experienced racers wanting to hone their skills. We recommend the dinghy private lesson if you consider yourself to be relatively active and comfortable around water. services.name: Facility rentals
services.desc: The Toronto Sailing & Canoe Club is centrally located but feels tucked away from the city. The site creates a special atmosphere for gatherings and events, offering expansive lake views in a protected harbour. The TS&CC clubhouse has generous spaces to eat, drink, and socialize, both indoors and out. For more information, rental rates, and/or to book a site visit, please contact our Vice Commodore. Book our lakeside clubhouse for your wedding, party, or company event. Note: Boats are not available for rent and facility rentals do not include boat access.
